subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of privileged GitHub Action revisions after the four guard assertions are repaired?
rationale: The pins have verified release provenance, but accepting substantial new third-party executable code at credential, publishing, scanning, maintenance, and agent boundaries remains a human trust decision.

options.title: Audit and accept batch
options.body: Review the privileged upstream deltas together and merge after guard repair and refreshed exact-head checks.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate token, publishing, scanning, maintenance, and Codex action families into smaller independently reviewed PRs.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Defer the batch until owners can complete the grouped supply-chain audit.

recommendation.title: Audit and accept batch
recommendation.body: Review the privileged upstream deltas together and merge after guard repair and refreshed exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly assigns the central security-scanning and token-minting workflow surfaces to this team.
